description: This file defines a custom exception class 'SavingsTransferTransactionsCannotBeUndoneException' used within the savings transfer module of the Apache Fineract financial platform. It extends a base domain rule exception and is thrown when an attempt is made to undo savings transfer transactions that are not allowed to be reversed.

classes.name: SavingsTransferTransactionsCannotBeUndoneException
classes.description: A specific exception class indicating that savings transfer transactions cannot be undone, used to enforce domain rules related to savings transfers.

methods.name: SavingsTransferTransactionsCannotBeUndoneException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with a specific error message and associated transaction ID.

calls: super("error.msg.savings.transfer.transactions.cannot.be.undone", "Transactions related to savings account transfers cannot be undone", transactionId)
